The Cliffs Hotel
Welcome to Cliffs Hotel, a family-owned hotel on Blackpool's beautiful seafront.
We offer a variety of spacious, comfortable rooms tailored to meet all your needs, whether you are looking for a romantic getaway or a family holiday. Our friendly team are on hand to make you feel at home and ensure you have everything you need for a memorable stay in Blackpool.

Accommodation | Cliffs Hotel
top of page
​
Indulge in comfort in our inviting double rooms ideal for couples or solo travellers.
Each room has been stylishly and thoughtfully designed, with all the essentials for a restful stay, so you can unwind in a space designed to make you feel at home for a peaceful night's sleep.
Cosy Doubles
Make your family getaway extra special in our Family Rooms, designed with space and comfort for all.
Sleeping up to six, these rooms have cosy bedding, practical amenities and a fun twist with an Xbox games console for endless entertainment. These rooms are perfect for creating memorable family moments in Blackpool.
Family Fun
Our comfortable and spacious Twin Comfort rooms are perfect for friends or colleagues. They feature two comfortable single beds with plush linen and everything you need to relax, unwind and sleep well.
Twin Comfort
Accommodation
What we offer
Our welcoming and stylish bedrooms are designed to provide all the comfort and privacy you need for a relaxing getaway.
​
Each room features an en-suite bathroom, with many offering fantastic views across Blackpool's world-famous Promenade, the sea and the iconic Blackpool Illuminations.
​
With a variety of room sizes available, there's something to suit everyone, from solo travellers and couples to larger families.
Sea view bedrooms with 32" flat screen televisions
Standard bedrooms all have 19" flat screen televisions
A wide range of Freeview channels
Tea & coffee making tray
Hairdryer
Complimentary toiletries
Iron and board available on request
Xbox consoles available in select family rooms
Room amenities
Deluxe Rooms
The luxurious new rooms include:
Nespresso Machine
Premium Dressing gown, slippers and towels
Tea, Coffee pods, Hot chocolate and biscuits
Early Check in & Late Check out
Reserved seating in the restaurant
Superking Bed or Twin plus Sofa bed

FAQs | Cliffs Hotel
top of page
FAQs
Accessibility Eat General Gift Vouchers Leisure Loyalty Stay
What are the check-in and check-out times at The Cliffs Hotel?
Check in starts at 12:30 and rooms will be available from 16:00 on check in days.
Is The Cliffs Hotel located near Blackpool’s major attractions?
Yes, Blackpool's town centre is just a few minutes away by tram.
Does The Cliffs Hotel offer free Wi-Fi?
Yes, wifi is free for all guests.
Is parking available at The Cliffs Hotel, and is it free?
On-site parking is free but limited and is on a first come, first served basis. We do not reserve spaces and parking on the surrounding streets is also free.
What types of rooms are available at The Cliffs Hotel?
The Cliffs Hotel has a variety of rooms, from Single Rooms to Family Rooms that sleep up to six.
Does The Cliffs Hotel have wheelchair-accessible rooms or facilities?
We have accessible rooms and facilities, but these can be limited during busy periods. To avoid disappointment, make sure to request accessible rooms when booking and not on arrival at the hotel.
Does The Cliffs Hotel offer special dietary options (e.g., vegetarian, gluten-free)?
Yes, we will cater to all dietary requirements on request. Please ensure that the Choice manager or restaurant manager is made aware of any requirements upon arrival.
Does The Cliffs Hotel have an indoor swimming pool?
Yes, The Cliffs Hotel pool is available to guests and non-residents daily.
Are spa or fitness facilities available at The Cliffs Hotel?
Yes, The Cliffs Hotel has a full leisure complex. This features an indoor pool, spa, sauna and gym.
Is there entertainment or live shows offered at The Cliffs Hotel?
Yes, we offer nightly entertainment. This includes everything from comedians to singers and cash prize bingo.
Does The Cliffs Hotel offer gift vouchers or loyalty programs?
Yes, gift vouchers are available to purchase at the hotel or via reservations. We also offer customers the chance to earn loyalty points with our Choice Rewards loyalty program.
Are cribs or extra beds available for children at The Cliffs Hotel?
Cots are available on request for most rooms where there is space. Extra beds can be requested, but most rooms cannot accommodate an extra bed.
Does The Cliffs Hotel offer room service?
No, at this point, The Cliffs does not offer room service.
What is the cancellation policy at The Cliffs Hotel?
We strongly recommend that you arrange travel insurance to cover losses incurred in the event of cancellation.
Deposits are non-refundable and non-transferable. In the event of cancellation at any time for any reason, we will retain the deposit as a cancellation charge.
For cancellations received within 72 hours of 3pm (hotel local time) we will ‘hold' the balance (the total paid less the non-refundable deposit) for use against a new booking made within three calendar months of the date of cancellation (subject to availability and price difference). This does not apply to Group Bookings of 10+ adults (please refer to your contract) or bookings for the Christmas and New Year packages - see below.
Any such sum ‘held' by us following cancellation of a booking would be available for use against a new booking at any Choice Hotel for three calendar months from the date of cancellation (subject to availability and price difference). If no new booking is made within three calendar months then the sum will be retained as a cancellation charge. Any new booking utilising this ‘held' sum need not arrive within this three calendar month period but must arrive within twelve calendar months of the original arrival date.
Any held sum can only be applied to one future booking, one time only. If the cost of the new reservation exceeds the held sum, the balance is payable at the time of booking. If the cost of the new reservation is less than the held sum, the difference is forfeit and no change, refund or credit will be issued.
If you are unable to stay, the entire sum (the held amount plus any additional payment received) will be retained as a cancellation charge. No date change, postponement, refund or credit is possible.
This does not apply to Group Bookings of 10+ adults (please refer to your contract) or bookings for the Christmas and New Year packages - see below.
If we have explicitly matched a non-refundable online rate, the online booking conditions relevant to that matched rate supersede the standard policies detailed here.
No reduction is made for temporary absence, meals not taken, late arrival or premature departure for any reason, nor for accommodation not required after confirmation of booking.
Is public transportation easily accessible from The Cliffs Hotel?
Yes, there is a tram stop directly opposite the hotel and bus stops within a hundred meters.

wikipedia.title: The Cliffs Hotel
wikipedia.extract: The Cliffs Hotel is in the seaside resort of Blackpool, Lancashire, It is located on the Queen's Promenade in the North Shore area of the town. The hotel was built in 1921. It is in the Baroque style and constructed of red brick and yellow terracotta. The gables have horizontal stripes. The Cliffs is owned by Choice Hotels Ltd and has 160 bedrooms.
